summary: Frontend-only test of the Next.js client: header and Case Studies link, homepage ServicesScroll (desktop, tablet and mobile), Who We Help, service detail hero, all body-region pages including the chip selector, blog detail hero, footer Facebook link, and regression on the main pages. Every requested flow passed. One content issue remains: /what-we-treat/ and the header dropdown list 15 published regions, not 11. The extras are 'testing-treatement' (id 25, found last iteration) and three newer duplicate regions: shoulder-neck-pain (33), back-sciatica-pain (32) and foot-ankle-pain (34), all created 2026-10-29 12:50. No data was modified.

design_issues.screen: /what-we-treat/ and header What We Treat dropdown
issues: 15 regions are shown, not 11. 'Shoulder & Neck Pain', 'Back & Sciatica Pain' and 'Foot & Ankle Pain' overlap with Neck/Shoulder, Low Back and Ankle/Foot. 'testing treatement' is a public test record with a typo. It has no sections, so its page shows no condition selector.
'Common signs and symptoms' shows only one bullet per condition. The CMS symptoms text is a single sentence, so it never splits into a list. This is a content limit, not a code bug.
The featured image is used as the hero background and is also repeated as a large image at the top of the body. Consider dropping one of them.
The Dry Needling stage image looks soft or low resolution at this size. Check the source image resolution.

Pre-existing since iteration 1: 404 on /fonts/FuturaPT-Book.woff2, FuturaPT-Demi.woff2 and BlairITCStd-Medium.woff2 (client/public/fonts is missing). These 404s are the only console errors on the public pages.

action_items: Confirm with the client, then unpublish or archive the extra conditions so exactly 11 body regions show: testing-treatement (id 25), shoulder-neck-pain (33), back-sciatica-pain (32), foot-ankle-pain (34)
Optional: add the missing brand font files to client/public/fonts or remove the @font-face rules
Optional: avoid showing the blog featured image twice (hero background and top of body)
critical_code_review_comments: ServicesScroll: if items is empty, items[active] is undefined and s.slug throws. Guard with `if (!items?.length) return null`.

ServicesScroll and ConditionSelector use IntersectionObserver with thin rootMargin bands. This worked in testing. Fast jumps (keyboard End, or anchor links) can skip a stage, but the final state is correct.
RegionDetail bullets() splits on sentence boundaries. Text like 'e.g. Pain' would split wrongly. Low risk.
Paragraph keys use p.slice(0,24), which can collide when two paragraphs start the same way. Use the index instead.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Results: header nav order is correct on desktop and in the mobile menu (mobile-nav-toggle). services-scroll is sticky: the .sticky child stays at top 96px while number 01..07, title and the Learn More href change. services-list-mobile has 7 items at 390px. who-card-* elements have no <a> and tabIndex -1. /services/dry-needling/ has hero-bg-image and detail-hero-cta pointing to /contact/#request-appointment. On neck-pain, clicking condition-chip-whiplash sets #whiplash and aria-current=true, and the section top lands at 160px, below the sticky selector at 80px. The active chip follows scroll. Anchors are spondylosis-neck / herniated-disc-neck and spondylosis-low-back / herniated-disc-low-back, with different text. All 15 region pages return 200 with one H1 and no overflow at 390px. The blog hero uses the /api/uploads featured image. social-facebook has the correct href, target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer. /contact/ never reaches networkidle because of the GHL and Cloudflare iframe, so use wait_until=load. Its CSP console errors come from Cloudflare (third party). The 401s on /admin/login come from /api/auth/me and are expected.
